question: For a Type C arrow board in Figure 6L-3, state its minimum size, legibility distance, minimum number of elements, and required categories of display modes.
model_answer: Direct Answer: Per Figure 6L-3, a Type C arrow board must have a minimum size of 96 x 48 inches, a minimum legibility distance of 1 mile, and a minimum of 15 elements. In addition, every arrow board (including Type C) must provide three categories of mode selections: (A) a Flashing Arrow, Sequential Arrow, or Sequential Chevron mode; (B) a flashing Double Arrow mode; and (C) a flashing Caution or Alternating Diamond mode. Standards (mandatory): - "Arrow boards shall meet the minimum size, legibility distance, number of elements, and other specifications shown in Figure 6L-3." For Type C, Figure 6L-3 specifies 96 x 48 inches minimum size, 1 mile minimum legibility distance, and 15 minimum elements. - "An arrow board shall have the following three mode selections: A. A Flashing Arrow, Sequential Arrow, or Sequential Chevron mode; B. A flashing Double Arrow mode; and C. A flashing Caution or Alternating Diamond mode." - "The arrow board shall have suitable elements capable of the various operating modes. The color presented by the elements shall be yellow." - "An arrow board shall be a sign with a matrix of elements capable of either flashing or sequential displays." Visual evidence: - [Image 1] Figure 6L-3 tabulates Type C as 96 x 48 inches minimum size, 1 mile minimum legibility distance, and 15 minimum elements, and illustrates the required display modes (Flashing Arrow, Sequential Arrow, Sequential Chevron, Flashing Double Arrow, Flashing Caution, and Alternating Diamond Caution) using a Type C arrow board. - [Image 5] Page 875 shows the full Figure 6L-3 page, confirming the Type C row (96 x 48 inches, 1 mile, 15 elements) and the three numbered operating-mode categories. - [Image 6] Page 874 shows the Section 6L.06 Standard text requiring conformance with Figure 6L-3 and listing the three required mode selections. Support (informational): Type C arrow boards are intended to be used on high-speed, high-volume motor vehicle traffic control projects. Citations: - Section 6L.06 Standard §5 (p.833) - Section 6L.06 Standard §16 (p.833) - Section 6L.06 Standard §13 (p.833) - Section 6L.06 Standard §1 (p.832) - Section 6L.06 Support §6 (p.833) - Figure 6L-3 (p.834) - Page 875 - Page 874
gold_answer: Minimum size 96 x 48 inches, minimum legibility distance 1 mile, and at least 15 elements. It must provide at least one directional merge mode, the flashing double-arrow mode, and at least one caution mode.
